chapters.label: Live: the Euro 2026 final
chapters.text: The Euro 2026 final. Portugal are losing to Spain, three to two. Then Pauleta scores! Three all!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: His special move is the pass across the box. Watch how he does it. He races down the left, gets to the end line, and rolls it across the goal.

chapters.label: Replay: the back post
chapters.text: Again, slowly. The keeper can’t reach it. At the back post, a teammate taps it in!

chapters.label: Practise it
chapters.text: Now you try. Pass across the box to the back post, where a teammate can tap it in!
